chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hisham ibn Salim and Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Indeed, a man may love you while not knowing what you are upon (in terms of Wilayah/authority), so Allah will enter him into Paradise due to his love for you; and indeed, a man may hate you while not knowing what you are upon, so Allah will enter him into the Fire due to his hatred for you.

key_terms.مَا أَنْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ: What you are upon (referring to Wilayah/authority)

ai.seo_question: Does a person need to know the exact status of the Imams to be rewarded for loving them?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi underscores the Shia doctrine of 'al-Wala' wa al-Bara' (loyalty and enmity), establishing that sincere affection for the Imams serves as a decisive criterion for Paradise, while animosity leads to Hellfire, regardless of the believer's precise theological understanding. It reflects the scholarly emphasis on the Imams' spiritual authority as the ultimate arbiter of divine acceptance, linking personal devotion directly to eschatological outcomes.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Salim, and Hafs Bin Al Bakhtary, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘The man would love you all and he does not recognise what you are upon (the Wilayah), so Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Enter him into the Paradise due to his love for you; and the man would hate you all and does not recognise what you are upon (the Wilayah), so Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Enter him into the Fire due to his hatred for you’.
en.sarwar: 10. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hisham ibn Salim and from Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “

The man loves you (followers of Ahl al-Bayt) without knowing your belief and Allah admits him to paradise because he loves you. A man hates you without knowing what your belief is and Allah then admits him in the fire for hating you.”
